title: CaseRecord
description: Tracks the status of a single data-broker opt-out request

broker_id.description: Unique identifier matching an entry in data/brokers.json

listing_url.description: URL of the discovered listing on the broker site, if found

status.description: Current stage of the opt-out request

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was first created

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the opt-out was submitted

deadline_at.description: ISO 8601 statutory response deadline (computed by deadlines.py)

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when removal was confirmed

mechanism.description: Opt-out mechanism used, matching references/mechanisms/* filenames

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter state code determining statutory language and deadline (e.g. 'CA', 'TX')

opt_out_url_used.description: Actual opt-out URL submitted to (may differ from brokers.json if verify_url.py resolved a fallback)

pii_sent.description: List of PII field names submitted to this broker (e.g. ['name', 'phone', 'state'])

human_action_required.description: Human-readable description of what the user needs to do (null if fully automated)

notes.description: Free-text notes, e.g. failure reason or dark-pattern description

audit_log.description: Chronological log of every state change and action taken on this case

action.description: Short description of the action taken

actor.description: Whether the agent or the user performed this action

detail.description: Additional detail (e.g. email subject line, form URL, error message)
